verdict.rationale: Travel-rate monitoring and rebooking is a fair question for a business cards and spend product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no travel booking, price monitoring, or rebooking capability in Wise Business. The FX rate lock in wise-docs-8 covers currency conversion for transfers, which is an adjacent feature and not travel rate monitoring.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have booked travel rates automatically monitored and rebooked when prices drop
